svg.title: Forge tank: open outlines
svg.desc: Every part of a tank species whose drawing has no closed outline. Green outlines were closed by rule and are already in use. Red strokes are left to close by hand: close them, or draw one closed path over them, inside the same group. Keep the group ids. Read the file back with: node tools/kit3d/kit3d.mjs import-outlines this-file.svg. The marks layer can be deleted.

g.text: 69 open parts: 65 closed by rule, 4 for you
Green is closed and already in use: change it if it is wrong. Red is yours: close the strokes, or draw one closed path over them in the same group. Paths keep their own coordinates.
